discussion:
# Principle

Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are administered in a secure, accountable and auditable manner.

# Indicators of Good Practice

Not effective:
- Administrative or management actions that modify systems, configurations or controls are not logged.
- Logs do not capture sufficient detail to identify who made a change, when and to what target.

Partially effective:
- Logging is enabled and provides useful coverage, but does not cover all applicable administrative or management platforms.
- Logs capture the administrator identity and action but lack detail on the target or change nature.

Fully effective:
- Comprehensive audit logging to capture all administrative or management actions is enabled on all platforms in scope.
- Logs capture administrator identity, timestamp, target object and nature of change.
title: Record all administrative or management actions that modify systems, configurations or controls, including the details of the associated user, timestamp and target.
